title: File:Table Mountain from Blouberg, South Africa (4028515275).jpg
claims: The Commons file is a general view of Table Mountain from Bloubergstrand across Table Bay; it is not a photograph of the UTCT race.
The author is South African Tourism, credited under CC BY 2.0; the original file is 6,144 x 4,096 pixels and 1,293,306 bytes, with a capture date of 5 January 2006.
The downloaded 960 px thumbnail is 960 x 640 pixels and 188,635 bytes; it shows the flat Table Mountain massif, Lion's Head to the right, the bay and a child running on the beach in the foreground.
The file page requires attribution and a licence notice; the route page uses the 960 px Commons thumbnail and credits South African Tourism and CC BY 2.0.
